pages.name: Tarrasch Defense: Tarrasch Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed the a4-knight via a3-c2 (impossible) and claimed a central majority; plan 1 had Black pressing a c5-pawn that cxb6 removes. Rewrote both: cxb6 e.p. because the knight has no safe retreat.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 6.g3 cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 called c4 and e4 White's target squares (they are Black's outposts); rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 around Nxd4 blockade and the ...d4 push once the knight leaves; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 6.g3 Nf6 (Prague)
pages.notes: Plan 4 listed Re8 and Qc7 as bare moves before castling; rewrote as ...Be7, ...O-O, ...Re8, ...Be6/...Bg4; British spelling (Defence, favourable, centre).

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 7.Bg2 Be6
pages.notes: Plans pushed d5-d4 with White's pawn on d4 and listed e4 as a move; plan 3 vague. Rewrote all four around dxc5 creating the IQP, Nd4 blockade, ...d4 hitting Nc3 and ...Ne4; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 7.Bg2 cxd4 8.Nxd4
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...d4 with White's knight on d4; now conditional on the blockader leaving; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 7.Bg2 cxd4 8.Nxd4 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 3 proposed a minority attack b2-b4-b5 (no White c-pawn); replaced with Be3/Bg5, Rc1, Qa4/Qb3 and Nxc6 bxc6 targeting c6/c5. Plan 2 ...d4 made conditional; British spelling (manoeuvring, centred).

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 7.Bg2 cxd4 8.Nxd4 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...d4 with White's knight on d4; made conditional; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 7.Bg2 cxd4 8.Nxd4 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...d5-d4 with White's knight on d4; made conditional; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 7.Bg2 cxd4 8.Nxd4 Be7 9.O-O O-O 10.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...d5-d4 into the d4-knight and suggested ...Qh4 against the g3 fianchetto; replaced with ...Re8, ...Bg4, ...Ng4 hitting e3 and a conditional d-pawn advance; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: Swedish, 7.Bg2
pages.notes: Plan 1 b3 break read as ambiguous and missed the main e4 idea; now e2-e4 or b2-b3; plan 2 adds ...Nge7; British spelling.
